headline: Production database will be destroyed and recreated; understand the downtime and recovery requirements
suppressed: Checkov flagged multiple pre-existing configuration gaps (missing monitoring, logging, WAF, bucket access blocks, etc.) but these are not introduced by this PR and represent the current state of the infrastructure.

findings.evidence_ref: Plan shows 'aws_db_instance.main' marked with '-/+ destroy and then create replacement' with 'storage_encrypted = false -> true # forces replacement'
findings.explanation: AWS RDS cannot enable encryption on an existing unencrypted instance; the resource must be destroyed and recreated. This will cause downtime on the production database. While a final snapshot will be created (skip_final_snapshot = false), the application will lose connectivity during the transition. No restore procedure or maintenance window is documented in this PR.
